anchor_comparisons: The positive ordinal anchor is directionally close because production readiness, capacity-exceeding requested demand, and FY2026 demand coverage coexist.
The counter ordinal anchor captures missing customer-lock and margin-bridge terms, but current production and demand evidence is stronger than that pattern alone.
disagreements: The analyst reflects current execution; the skeptic correctly separates demand indications from binding obligations; the calibrated band lies between them.
payload.rationale: Calibration recognizes HBM4 production, customer demand above capacity, FY2026 coverage, and completed discussions. It withholds a higher placement because duration and economics remain unsettled and platform timing plus competitive supply can alter mix and allocation.
payload.why_not_higher: No executed multi-year volume-price-cancellation framework is disclosed, and platform delay or new supply can reduce visibility.
payload.why_not_lower: Actual HBM4 execution, capacity constraints, customer requests, and FY2026 coverage exceed a provisional narrative.
